title: Saudian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine, featuring marinated lamb kebabs grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or roasted vegetables.
